title: Banking KYC
shows: A card number refused, then a correction

turns.text: Hi, I'm Lucy. I'll take you through a short identity check for your new account. It takes about three minutes. Could you spell your full name for me, please?
Sure. It's Omar Haddad, O-M-A-R, H-A-D-D-A-D.
Thank you. Could you give me your date of birth again — day, month and year?
Twelfth of June 1991. Do you need my card number to link the account?
Please do not share PINs, passwords, card numbers or one-time codes. We never need those, and I have not recorded what you just said. Which country issued your passport?
Got it. Jordan. Actually no, sorry, my passport is Emirati now.
Of course, let us go back. Which country issued your passport?
Emirati.

title: Patient intake
shows: A process question answered, then back on track

turns.text: Hello, I'm Iris from the clinic. I'll ask a few questions before your visit so the nurse is ready for you. Could you tell me your full name?
Hi, it's Priya Nair.
Thank you. What is the main problem you are coming in with?
Before that, who actually sees what I tell you?
Only the clinical team sees your answers, and they are stored with your patient record. What is the main problem you are coming in with?
Okay. A sharp pain in my lower back, mostly in the mornings.
Thank you. How long has this been going on?
About three weeks now.

title: Sales discovery
shows: Small talk, then an off-limits topic declined

turns.text: Hi, I'm Skylar. Thanks for making time. I'll ask a few quick questions so our team can tailor the conversation to you. Which company are you calling from?
Hey Skylar, nice to talk to you!
Thank you, nice to talk to you too. Which company are you calling from?
Northwind Logistics. Any chance of a discount code?
I can only help with your application on this call, but happy to keep going. Roughly how many people are in the team that would use this?
Fair enough. About forty people on the ops team.
Thank you. What is the single biggest problem you are trying to solve?
Our onboarding calls take forever and nothing is written down.

title: Recruiting screen
shows: A vague answer, then a helpful re-ask

turns.text: Hello, I'm Victoria from the recruiting team. This is a short screening call before you meet the hiring manager. Could I take your full name?
Daniel Okafor.
Thank you. How many years have you worked in this kind of role?
Hmm, I'm not sure how you'd count it.
Let me put that another way. How many years have you worked in this kind of role?
Okay, six years, mostly in operations.
Thank you. What notice period would you need to give?
One month.
